content:
alex: T-minus 20 until the RC rollout on prod-shard-4. I'm the deploy owner. Starting canary at 15:40 UTC. Who's on smoke/monitoring?

mira: I'm on smoke. I'll run the latency/error checks and report back.

sam: oncall-sre: I'll monitor alerts and stand by for rollback. If we hit sustained error >1% for 2m I will execute revert.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by alex: runtime v3.6 -> prod-shard-4. Canary 2% for 10m, then progressive ramp.

alex: Quick preflight checklist: 1) DB migration: none. 2) Feature flags set: `runtime_v3_6=true` (prod). 3) Canary dashboards up. 4) Rollback doc: https://intra.redwood/ops/rollbacks/runtime-v3.6

mira: Smoke steps (short):
- run `scripts/smoke_prod.sh shard=4`
- run throughput probe: `wrk -t2 -c50 http://prod-shard-4/runtime/health`
- check `errors.rate` and `latency.p95`
I'll paste numbers as I go.

jon: FYI watch `cache.kv.miss.p95` and `inference.kv.latency` — we saw a small regression in staging earlier.

lina: I've validated alert routing and escalations. Pager goes to sam, then senior-sre.

sam: Rollback CLI ready locally: `infra rollback --service runtime --to v3.5 --shard 4` (I'll only run if we breach the rollback threshold).

alex: Canary started. mira, please confirm p50 <120ms and errors <0.5% for canary window.

mira: 2m in: p50=98ms, p95=135ms (a touch high), errors=0.12%. Annotating. If p95 stays >180ms I'll request pause.

jon: Noted — I see a short p95 bump tied to long prompt traces. I'm streaming canary logs to `/var/log/runtime/canary.log`.

mira: 6m: p95 back to 110ms, errors 0.10%. OK to increase to 5% canary.

alex: Bumping to 5% now, will wait 10m and then move to 25% if stable.

sam: Monitoring error budget and infra metrics. I have rollback command staged.

mira: 12m: p95=115ms, errors=0.08%, cache miss unchanged. Green for 25%. :thumbsup:

alex: Moving to 25% in 2m. Ops note: if offline worker count drops below expected, we'll pause and investigate.

jon: Spotted a small increase in `throttled.requests` during ramp — keeping an eye, but not critical yet.

mira: 20m: p95=108ms, errors=0.09%, throttles back to baseline. Approving full ramp.

sam: All alerts quiet. Proceeding with ramp; will trigger rollback if errors >1% sustained 2m.

alex: Rolling to 100% now over 20m. Thanks everyone for quick checks.

mira: Final: all smoke checks pass, metrics look stable. Approved. :white_check_mark:

alex: Rollout complete on prod-shard-4. Closing the thread — nice work.

deploy-bot: Deploy complete: runtime v3.6 -> prod-shard-4. Duration: 42m.
